title: Neural chip decodes interactions between brain regions
script:
Researchers at EPFL designed a neural chip that decodes interactions between brain regions.
The device maps how different parts of the brain communicate with each other in real time.
It tackles a major challenge in neuroscience by tracking multiple neural circuits simultaneously.
The microchip monitors electrical activity across distinct cortical areas.
This advance helps scientists better understand complex neurological disorders and improves brain computer interfaces.
Would you trust this tech inside your head?
